Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human sodium-dependent dopamine transporter (CHEMBL238). Join molecule_dictionary to activities and assays to target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key and docs for pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter target by chembl_id CHEMBL238 and activities by standard_type IC50. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate.
